configuration: Full predicted-plan PWR: trained planner and duplex interaction model with online plan updates; excludes oracle plans.
sources_read: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.04970v1 (v1; method, experiments, qualitative results, limitations, Appendices A and G)

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: Current video evidence updates the cached plan's progress and recovery state.

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: Cached plans and dialogue history condition interruption, silence, and guidance.

A->S.label: reported
A->S.rationale: Planner-generated visual expectations guide interpretation; plan-update timestamps determine sampled clips.

M->S.label: reported
M->S.rationale: Retained plan cues directly guide visual interpretation; retained update timestamps anchor clip selection.

A->M.label: reported
A->M.rationale: Duplex decisions and utterances enter planner updates retained as the next cached plan.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: Generated procedural decisions persist in cached plans for subsequent passes.
record.quote: procedural memory lives in the plan

outcome.label: stated
outcome.rationale: Observed completion or deviation of guided steps is retained in updated plan status.
outcome.quote: as steps complete or the user deviates.

attribution.label: stated
attribution.rationale: Observations are checked against the previous guidance-consistent plan to advance or correct assistance.
attribution.quote: inspecting $o_{t}$ against $P_{t-1}$ and emitting the appropriate updated plan.

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: Online changes concern task state; supervised training is external. Baseline prompt-rewriting ablations are outside this configuration.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: Subsequent passes use updated task plans, without a reported service-revised mechanism.

notes: Text-only review; memory is session-local. Outcome and attribution concern procedural monitoring, not author-side benchmark grading.
